services.title: AI & Automation
services.short: Repetitive work that depends on one person remembering every step.
services.summary: Enquiry routing, messaging flows, internal triaging, document summarisation and scheduled background jobs — the work that never stops because it never changes.
deliverables: Enquiry intake with automatic classification, routing and SLA clocks
AI-assisted drafting with a human approval step before anything is sent
Integrations between the tools the business already pays for
Scheduled jobs: digests, reminders, reconciliations, exception reports
Runbook, failure modes and monitoring for every workflow shipped
outcomes: Fewer enquiries waiting for a first reply
No double entry between systems
Every repeat task traceable and auditable
services.engagement: Fixed-scope build, staged with a demo at each stage
services.notFor: Work that needs human judgement, taste or accountability. We automate the repeatable, not the responsible.

services.title: Websites & Digital Products
services.short: A credible public presence that turns attention into enquiries.
services.summary: Company websites, landing pages, client portals and small scoped digital products — built for conversion, speed and ownership rather than for a template.
deliverables: Brand, structure and content architecture before any pixel work
Responsive build with Core Web Vitals in budget
Enquiry capture wired to the client's own inbox and pipeline
Self-hosted, no-tracking, no-lock-in stack
Documentation, deployment pipeline and handover training
outcomes: A site that loads fast on a mid-range phone
Enquiries land where the team already works
Full source and hosting ownership on day one
services.engagement: Fixed scope, fixed price, staged demos
services.notFor: Rebrands that need a full identity programme, or sites that need a content team to keep alive.

services.title: Research & Market Intelligence
services.short: Decisions made on evidence instead of assumptions.
services.summary: Competitor audits, market mapping, tooling evaluations and structured feasibility briefs — so the decision is made once, on facts.
deliverables: Competitor and pricing landscape with source links
Market sizing with stated assumptions
Tool evaluations against the business's actual constraints
Feasibility brief with a clear recommendation
Raw research files handed over, not just the summary
outcomes: A decision that does not need to be re-litigated later
Comparable quotes from real vendors
A shortlist that survives contact with reality
services.notFor: Primary market research requiring paid databases, or anything needing a large sample survey.

services.title: Business Strategy & Documentation
services.short: Processes written down clearly enough to delegate.
services.summary: Operating manuals, standard operating procedures, process documentation, decision logs and handover guides — the work that usually only lives in one person's head.
deliverables: As-is process map with friction points marked
Standard operating procedures for the work that matters
Decision log: what was decided, when and why
Ownership and escalation matrix
Handover pack that a new hire can follow on day one
outcomes: The founder can take leave without the business stalling
New staff onboard faster and with fewer errors
Processes survive people leaving
services.engagement: Usually 1–3 week engagement, sometimes part of a build
services.notFor: Strategy decks that will never be read or acted on.

services.title: Marketing, Branding & Content
services.short: A consistent message and a repeatable publishing rhythm.
services.summary: Brand materials, content systems, lead capture funnels and automated follow-up sequences — so marketing stops depending on inspiration.
deliverables: Message framework: who it is for and why they should care
Core brand assets and a one-page usage guide
Publishing calendar with production workflow
Landing pages wired to the enquiry pipeline
Follow-up sequences that sound like a person
outcomes: Publishing that happens without heroics
Leads captured with context attached
Follow-up that is timely instead of pushy
services.engagement: Monthly retainer or a defined campaign build
services.notFor: Volume content production for brands that need an in-house editorial team.

services.title: Software & Integrations
services.short: Tools that talk to each other, and the specific job nothing handles.
services.summary: Custom scripts, API connectors, spreadsheet automations and webhooks — the glue that removes the manual step between two systems that will never be replaced.
deliverables: Integration design with error handling and retries
Custom scripts and webhooks with logging
Spreadsheet automations for Google Sheets and Excel
Documentation, credentials handover and a rollback plan
Monitoring so silent failures are caught
outcomes: One entry, one source of truth
No re-keying between systems
Failures visible instead of silent
services.notFor: Replacing a system the business just paid to implement. We integrate around what you have.

services.title: Consultation & Direction
services.short: A clear-thinking outside view before money is spent.
services.summary: Technical guidance, architecture advice, vendor evaluation and fractional systems leadership for owner-operated businesses that need clarity, not another contractor.
deliverables: Structured diagnostic of the real operating problem
Written recommendation with options and trade-offs
Vendor evaluation criteria and shortlist
Architecture advice for tools the business already owns
Ongoing fractional leadership, if that is what is needed
outcomes: A decision that is yours to make
Fewer expensive wrong turns
A plan written in your language, not ours
services.engagement: Single sessions, the fixed-fee audit, or fractional advisory
services.notFor: Advice we cannot stand behind. If the honest answer is “you do not need this”, that is the answer.
